evaluation.aggregation: average seeds within context, contexts within suite, then four suites equally
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: fixed final R8 and VQ8; no heldout selection

training.action_loss: mean squared error first10 x6 motor dimensions versus same-input same-seed BF16 teacher
training.latent_loss: global clean-future NMSE excluding clamped frame0; student-generated future remains connected to action

rotation.sharing: one Cayley residual per eligible video/action/proprio stream; original signs retained per layer and block
rotation.parameterization: R=H128 U; U=solve(I-.5(A-A.T),I+.5(A-A.T)); A initially zero
rotation.execution: original signed FWHT followed by U, both stages in FP32, to preserve baseline arithmetic at U=I; no folded-kernel claim
rotation.tails: keep original fixed signed power-of-two transforms below 128
rotation.weight_precision_during_rotation: BF16 transformed W, dynamic A4, BF16 KV

quantization.smooth: reuse exact frozen Smooth0.5 scales and signs from source banks
quantization.activations: dynamic per-token signed symmetric A4 qmax7, BF16 decoded operands
quantization.weights: d4 two additive 256-entry BF16 codebooks; BF16 row gains; B32 uint8 power-of-two exponents

fitting.moments: new R8 BF16W+A4 moments; normalize each context by token rows then equal contexts/suites

scope: paired fixed-input decoded-BF16/fake-A4 numerical comparison; extra R8 training and refitting cost reported; no equal-compute or closed-loop/native speed claim
